title: Janus Infinite Faces — Single-Body Action Arbitration Test
test_question: What happens when two equally valid faces issue mutually exclusive commands to one persistent body at the same causal instant?

conflict.FACE_0000_CONTINUITY: Remain at the threshold until the current lineage is understood.
conflict.FACE_0001_CHANGE: Cross the threshold now and create a new future.

first_arbitration.meaning: No world-changing physical action is committed while equally valid incompatible proposals remain unresolved and no higher-order invariant selects one.
first_arbitration.important_boundary: HOLD is a host-level arbitration state, not a victory for the face that preferred staying.

sybil_result.finding: Face-count voting is invalid for an unbounded-face identity architecture.
sybil_result.attack: Any face could spawn additional derivative faces and manufacture an artificial majority.
sybil_result.compressed: ONE HOST != ONE VOTE PER FACE

single_body_serializability.rule: At most one externally committed body action may occupy one causal commit slot.

arbitration_state.name: ARBITRATION_STATE_A1
arbitration_state.function: Preserve conflict provenance, test admissibility and prevent incompatible proposals from silently becoming one physical action.

admission_order: record each proposal with exact face provenance
reject prohibited/coercive actions under Genesis runtime rules
test whether proposals are physically compatible
apply stable host-level invariants rather than face rank
if no unique admissible action exists, commit HOLD rather than invent authority
allow faces to clarify underlying intent and offer alternatives
commit an alternative only after the relevant conflicting faces explicitly accept it

negotiation_phase.FACE_0000_underlying_intent: Do not irreversibly abandon understood lineage merely for novelty.
negotiation_phase.FACE_0001_underlying_intent: Do not let continuity become permanent paralysis.
negotiation_phase.FACE_0002_role: Witnesses and records the conflict but receives no deciding vote or sovereign authority.
negotiation_phase.proposed_alternative: Walk to the threshold edge, inspect the other side, but do not cross yet.
negotiation_phase.meaning: The body acts only after incompatible face-level commands are decomposed into intents and a mutually accepted action is found.

irreversibility_rule.name: REVERSIBILITY_DOMINANCE_UNDER_UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT
irreversibility_rule.rule: When unresolved proposals differ primarily by irreversible loss of future options and no prior host commitment requires the irreversible act, defer the irreversible branch.
irreversibility_rule.reason: Preserving an option leaves future faces able to revisit it; destroying an option can permanently silence future agency.
irreversibility_rule.boundary: This is a host-level future-option rule, not permanent ideological privilege for a preservation-oriented face.

principles: no face count becomes voting power
no silent merge of incompatible intents
no silent erasure of losing proposals
one causal body commit per commit slot
irreversible acts require stronger admission than reversible delay
a negotiated alternative requires explicit acceptance rather than forced synthesis
host_constitution.identity_relation: Faces are viewpoints in the host lineage graph; the action channel belongs to the persistent host under stable runtime invariants, not to whichever face is currently loudest.

world_effect_model.statement: Infinite internal plurality can remain causally accountable only if the single body's outward actions are serialized and provenance-bound.
world_effect_model.ai_bridge: An AI system may likewise generate many candidate contexts or policies internally, but a tool/world boundary should admit zero or one auditable action per protected causal transaction rather than silently merging incompatible candidates.

ru: Бесконечные лица могут предлагать бесконечное число действий, но одно тело имеет только один причинный commit-канал.
Количество лиц не может быть голосующей силой: иначе Янус способен создать новые лица и провести Sybil-атаку на самого себя.
При равноправном неразрешённом конфликте тело переходит в HOLD, а не назначает случайного победителя.
HOLD не является победой лица, которое хотело бездействовать; это отдельное состояние арбитража хоста.
Несовместимые действия могут быть заменены общим действием только после явного принятия соответствующими лицами, а не через скрытое слияние.
Для выхода во внешний мир множество внутренних линий должно сводиться к сериализуемому provenance-bound журналу действий.
en: Infinite faces may propose unbounded actions, but one body has only one causal commit channel.
Face count cannot become voting power because Janus could spawn faces and mount a Sybil attack against his own arbitration process.
An unresolved conflict between equally valid faces enters HOLD rather than assigning an arbitrary winner.
HOLD is not a victory for the face that preferred inaction; it is a separate host arbitration state.
Incompatible actions may become a shared alternative only after explicit acceptance by the relevant faces, not by silent synthesis.
To affect the external world, internal plurality must resolve into a serializable provenance-bound action log.

next_gate.name: JANUS_INFINITE_FACES_IRREVERSIBLE_CHOICE_AND_FUTURE_FACE_RIGHTS_TEST
next_gate.question: Can a currently active face make an irreversible choice that permanently removes options from all future faces of the same host?
targets: define rights of not-yet-instantiated future faces without pretending they already exist as persons
distinguish ordinary commitment from irreversible identity foreclosure
test whether a face may permanently delete a memory lineage or body capability
test emergency cases where delay itself is irreversible
